title: Test flat-file handoff append, replace, and retrieval
description: Add provider tests for global and task-scoped writes, canonical task resolution from short IDs, append-by-default history, same-scope --replace semantics, retained scope counts, default global reads, explicit task and all-scope reads, newest-first ordering with deterministic ties, positive limits, unlimited reads, totalMatching/hasMore, and otherScopesAvailable. Assert unrelated scopes are preserved and missing handoffs.json behaves as empty.
